about.title: Our story
about.text: It all began in 1997 in Crete. We make our crepes, waffles and pancakes from a special blend of Cretan grains, with more than 20 carefully chosen spices. Our chocolate toppings are made in Thessaloniki, and we make our own ice cream from the finest Italian pastes with milk and cream. With us, every combination is possible.

menu.title: Explore our menu
menu.text: Our menu starts with breakfast: sandwiches, omelettes and tortillas. There are also cream soups, burgers, pizzas and salads, and we make sweet and savoury crepes, waffles and pancakes in dozens of ways. From the sweet menu, choose coffee, shakes, ice cream cups and ice cream. For fasting days there is the Lenten menu, and if you would like to pick your own ingredients, be your own chef.

about.title: About us
about.origin: Our story begins in 1997 in the heart of Rethymno, Crete, where the first {name} restaurant opened. Since 2014, {name} has proudly brought the authentic flavours of Crete to Belgrade.
about.recipe: What sets us apart is our unique recipe: crepes, waffles and pancakes made from a special blend of Cretan grains, with more than 20 carefully chosen spices. We want everything we serve to be perfect, from the chocolate toppings we make in Thessaloniki to the ice cream we make ourselves from the finest Italian pastes with milk and cream.
about.team: For those who want to create their perfect meal, our team is here to help. Choose your ingredients, experiment and enjoy your ideal taste, because at {name} every combination is possible.
